 What Do Latest Power Utilities Results Show for (NSE:JPPOWER), (NSE:RPOWER) and (NSE:VEDPOWER)?

 Key Highlights 
 Jaiprakash Power Ventures' board approved unaudited standalone and consolidated results for the quarter and half-year ended 30 September 2026 on 19 October 2026.
 Reliance Power's latest verified results are for the June quarter.
 Vedanta Power began trading as a standalone company after the demerger of Vedanta Limited's merchant power undertaking took effect on 1 May 2026.
 Sector overview 
 India's listed power generators are reporting a mixed set of numbers as the September-quarter season unfolds. Jaiprakash Power Ventures has published Q2 FY27 results, while Reliance Power and the newly demerged Vedanta Power have so far disclosed only June-quarter figures. This article, current to 28 October 2026, 04:40 IST, reviews the latest verified disclosures for each company. It is a factual summary of disclosures and offers no investment advice, price views or recommendations to readers.
 Jaiprakash Power Ventures (NSE:JPPOWER) 
 Jaiprakash Power Ventures' board approved unaudited standalone and consolidated results for the quarter and half-year ended 30 September 2026 on 19 October 2026. Press summaries of the consolidated numbers put revenue at about Rs 1,512 crore, against Rs 1,438 crore a year earlier, with net profit of roughly Rs 33 crore, down from about Rs 182 crore. The filing summary describes a Rs 511 crore provision linked to a settlement offer from NARCL on a corporate guarantee claim, and an exceptional item of Rs 193.63 crore for the half-year from surrendering two coal mines. The auditors expressed a qualified conclusion about non-provisioning of a lender recompense claim of about Rs 5,697 crore, which the company disputes. These matters are detailed in the filing notes. The board also named Jigar Dalal as chief financial officer from 1 November 2026. Figures come from secondary press summaries rather than the primary filing itself.
 Reliance Power (NSE:RPOWER) 
 Reliance Power's latest verified results are for the June quarter. Its board approved them on 6 August 2026, and press reports state consolidated net profit of Rs 64.71 crore, compared with Rs 44.68 crore a year earlier. Revenue from operations was reported at Rs 1,956.32 crore, up 3.75 per cent from Rs 1,885.58 crore. Total income was Rs 2,103.75 crore. The company noted discontinued operations, including the Chitrangi, Shahapur, wind and Dadri projects, which had a negligible profit before tax. No date for the September-quarter board meeting could be confirmed from the sources reviewed, and no more recent company announcement was found in the preceding week. Earlier this year, in May 2026, the board also considered raising long-term funds through equity or debt instruments, though the outcome was not confirmed here. Readers should consult the exchange filings for the forthcoming results date and for any further announcements about funding plans.
 Vedanta Power (NSE:VEDPOWER) 
 Vedanta Power began trading as a standalone company after the demerger of Vedanta Limited's merchant power undertaking took effect on 1 May 2026. For the June quarter, reported on 29 July 2026, consolidated revenue from operations was Rs 2,595 crore, up from Rs 1,981 crore a year earlier. Power sales rose 38 per cent to about 5,224 million units. EBITDA was Rs 291 crore, compared with Rs 417 crore a year earlier, and the company cited a boiler incident at its Sakti plant as having affected the quarter. It reported a consolidated net loss of Rs 423 crore, weighed down by a net exceptional loss of Rs 487 crore, which included a Rs 127 crore charge tied to a Supreme Court penalty over declared capacity. The company also faces ongoing scrutiny of declared capacity matters. The date of its Q2 FY27 results could not be confirmed from the sources reviewed.
 Comparison 
 Only Jaiprakash Power has so far reported September-quarter figures, so a like-for-like comparison across the three is not yet possible. Its revenue rose modestly while profit fell, reflecting exceptional items and disputed claims. Reliance Power and Vedanta Power are compared on June-quarter data, where one posted a small profit and the other a sizeable loss after exceptionals. The coming results, once published, will help to clarify how each company's one-off charges and legal matters evolve.
 Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) 
 Q: Which reporting period has Jaiprakash Power Ventures (JPPOWER) most recently disclosed results for? 
 A: Jaiprakash Power Ventures' board approved unaudited standalone and consolidated results for the quarter and half-year ended 30 September 2026 on 19 October 2026.
 Q: What changed in quarterly profitability at Reliance Power (RPOWER)? 
 A: Reliance Power's latest verified results are for the June quarter. Its board approved them on 6 August 2026, and press reports state consolidated net profit of Rs 64.71 crore, compared with Rs 44.68 crore a year earlier.
 Q: What should investors know about the disclosed developments at Vedanta Power (VEDPOWER)? 
 A: Vedanta Power began trading as a standalone company after the demerger of Vedanta Limited's merchant power undertaking took effect on 1 May 2026.
